author: Insta360
description:
What does it take to go from 14,000 feet in the sky to 30 meters beneath the ocean? This is the ultimate extreme sports challenge — one journey through skydiving, hot air balloon jumping, bungee jumping, rock climbing, deep water soloing, freediving, and scuba diving. All captured on Insta360 X5 & Ace Pro 2.

From fast-moving freefalls to deep underwater descents, X5 & Ace Pro 2 capture every challenge in immersive quality. Their all-around perspective records the action from every direction, so you can relive each jump, landing, climb, and dive — and reframe the best angles after the moment has already happened.

The adventure begins with earning a skydiving A license: ground school, 25 jumps, canopy control, low-altitude exits, and a final skills test. Dangerous landings, a near parachute-line entanglement, and repeated freefall failures reveal the real challenge — learning to control fear without losing respect for the risk.
